text:
97 PRs merged this week. Grok 4.7, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and Luna, and several other models moved into the garden. Qwen Image 2.1 brought reference edits; Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and MiniMax H3 Max video joined too. Routes got sturdier without making callers rename things.

`polli mcp` can now discover and install tools for 13 coding clients. People kept adding apps and agents, Enter got a little calmer, and newly qualifying issue reports earn 4 Pollen. Software gardening, mostly. 🌱

Code and updates: github.com/pollinations/pollinations
